item.title: Blind student and guide dog share adventures in Scotland
item.description: ABC News' Danny New speaks with a blind college student from Virginia who is traveling with her guide dog Beasley while continuing her education in Scotland.

item.title: Russian envoy says Iran visit aims to prevent return to war
item.description: Russia's top diplomat is visiting Tehran for the first time since the U.S. launched its war with Iran, aiming to prevent a return to major hostilities.

item.title: Trump pushes states to repeal laws regulating new hospitals
item.description: The Trump administration has tied billions in rural health funding for states partly to policy commitments, including ending their certificate-of-need laws.

item.title: Cartel members linked to murders of 10 workers from Canadian company
item.description: The bodies of the 10 men, including two engineers and one geologist, were later found buried in clandestine graves.
